name: p-sugar
js: (() => { const a = window.__CITY_APP; const tg = a.tourGuide; const out = {}; for (const q of ['Sugar Beach','Cinesphere','Ontario Place','Centre Island','Kensington Market','Toronto Music Garden','Jack Layton Ferry Terminal','Queens Quay Terminal','High Park Zoo','Grenadier Pond','Casa Loma','Eglinton','Biidaasige Park','Nathan Phillips Square','Freedom Arches','Union Station','Harbourfront Centre','St. Lawrence Market','Distillery District','Royal Ontario Museum','Ontario Legislative Building','Toronto City Hall','Rogers Centre','CN Tower']) { const r = tg.search(q); out[q] = r.slice(0,3).map(h => [h.name, h.kind, Math.round(h.x), Math.round(h.z)]); } const p = tg.search('Sugar Beach')[0]; tg.teleportToPlace(p); tg.showPlace(p, { fly: false }); out.frame = { w: window.CITY.WORLD_W, keys: Object.keys(window.CITY).slice(0,60) }; return out; })()
